brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished five commercial shops on Hasaka Road in the northwestern area of Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolitions destroyed businesses in the area, affecting local merchants and the surrounding commercial district.

The operation marks the latest in a series of demolitions carried out by Israeli authorities in occupied Palestinian territories, which Palestinians and international observers say destroy livelihoods and alter the urban landscape.
title: Israeli forces demolish five commercial shops on road north of Hebron
